title: YourMondayMotivator: Is anyone out there & experience is overrated
html:
This morning I am wondering if anyone is actually going to read today's MondayMotivator. It's a public holiday in New Zealand and a beautiful day where we are. Hopefully everyone will get out and enjoy it before they check their emails.

This being the first MondayMotivator, I really want to make it a cracker which makes me and you think. The pressure is on ...

There is a Hindu Proverb that goes, "No physician is really good before he has killed one or two patients."

This year I'm going to try and do things instead of thinking I don't have the experience yet to do that and putting them off.

Too often I hear people putting things off business wise or personally and it got me thinking experience is overrated. Would Richard Pearse have flown or men walked on the moon if experience was necessary?

I'm not sure I want to kill a few patients but I'm happy to make some mistakes so I can move forward faster.

Have a great week.
My best.

Glenn

P.S. Check out the book winners at facebook.com/mondaymotivator. I haven't heard from all of them.
